links.comparator_used: Blinded bilingual clinician review (reference standard) of a randomly selected subset of translations
links.outcome: Agreement of MQM-based LLM-as-a-judge scores with clinician assessment of Spanish discharge instruction translations (Cohen's kappa)
links.effect: LLM MQM vs clinician kappa -0.18 to 0.20 (slight); clinician-clinician kappa -0.11 to 0.49 (slight to moderate)
links.quote: Agreement between LLM-based MQM scoring and clinician assessment was generally slight across domains (κ = −0.18 to 0.20), whereas inter-rater agreement between clinicians ranged from slight to moderate (κ = −0.11 to 0.49), highlighting the inherent subjectivity of clinical translation assessment.

design_hint: clinician review of LLM translations (layered evaluation with automated metrics and LLM-judge)
